ios.desc:
Powerful org-mode, finally at home on iOS.

Plan your day, capture notes and links, and track time in your own .org files on iPhone and iPad.

PLAN YOUR DAY
See today's tasks alongside optional Calendar events and Reminders. Browse your week or month, or use Agenda filters for priorities, habits and completed items. Upcoming items are grouped by week and day, with later weeks tucked away until you need them.

CAPTURE A NOTE OR A TASK
Save an idea without giving it a TODO state or priority. Share text or a web link to Orger, add your own comments, and choose an org file. Shared text and links default to Note; switch to Task when you want an action item. Source links are kept when the sharing app provides them.

TRACK YOUR TIME
Clock in and out of a task with the free Manual Clock and keep the time log in your Org file. Optional Full Access adds adjustable Focus Timer sessions with saved time history.

KEEP YOUR ORG WORKFLOW
Open a folder in Files to browse and edit your .org files. Change task states, dates, priorities, tags and notes, or browse heading outlines. Set your own active and completed keywords once in Settings for all your files. Ordinary headings can stay free of states and priorities.

START FREE
Planner, Agenda browsing and filters, note and task capture, Manual Clock, habits, widgets, notifications, Calendar and Reminders integration, and one connected org folder are included free.

OPTIONAL FULL ACCESS
A one-time purchase adds Agenda text search, formatted export, Focus Timer sessions with saved time history, and additional color themes. See the local price in the app. Optional coffee tips support development and do not unlock features.

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
Orger processes your org files on your device. No Orger account, advertising, or developer-operated sync server. Choose your folder through Files; availability and syncing depend on your storage provider. Shared captures may wait until you open Orger and the destination folder is accessible. Calendar and Reminders permissions are optional.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later.
Support: https://support.toblergis.com/orger/
Privacy: https://support.toblergis.com/orger/privacy
